name: native-command-error.json
lua_assertions:
local calls = 0
frozen:addcommand('Bad', function() error('native callback failure') end)
frozen:addcommand('Good', function(self) calls = calls + 1; self:x(calls) end)
for i = 1, 2 do frozen:playcommand('Bad'); frozen:playcommand('Good') end
assert(calls == 2 and frozen:GetX() == 2)
